title: Birth, New Orleans neighborhood and father Spencer Murray's band
summary: Murray was born in 1896 near Eucousine Street; his father Spencer Murray played guitar and led his own band at Tom Anderson's, and his mother's family were country musicians in Livingston Parish.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I was born in 1896. Exact birthday? What month? 1896, October the night. 1325 South, no, 12-0. I'm going to get my house ready. You know how it is in conversation. I'm on 1225 Eucousine Street. Where is that? That's where the IC railroad track goes out. See, that's all been demolished now. Howard Avenue was on the uptown side of the new basin and the old basin. On the downtown side of the new basin was Julia Street. And I was born between Eucousine, between Magnolia and Robinson.
A lot of musicians in that neighborhood when you were a kid? A lot of music?

Well, my father was a musician. What did he play? He played guitar. In fact, all my family, my uncle, on my mother's side, they was musicians out in the country, in Morripass, Louisiana. That's in Livingston Parish. And my father, he played at Tom Anderson. That was located then on North Ramport, in the 200 block of North Ramport. Same block where they, I think they have the athletic club down in there now. He played over there. What did he play with there? Well, he had his own band. And what was his name? His name was Spencer Murray. He had his own band. And he was also, he worked in the daytime, break the airport of the city.
